name: microsoft_docs_search
title: Microsoft Docs Search
description:
Search official Microsoft/Azure documentation for the most relevant and trustworthy content.
Returns up to 10 high-quality content chunks with title, URL, and excerpt.

## Usage:
Always use this tool first to ground answers in official Microsoft/Azure knowledge when facing Microsoft/Azure related questions, then use microsoft_docs_fetch for complete page content when needed.

query.description: a query or topic about Microsoft/Azure products, services, platforms, developer tools, frameworks, or APIs

name: microsoft_code_sample_search
title: Microsoft Code Sample Search
description:
Search for code snippets in official Microsoft Learn documentation.
Returns relevant code samples with practical implementation examples for Microsoft/Azure products. Helps you use the **LATEST OFFICIAL** code snippets.

## When to Use:
- When providing sample Microsoft/Azure related code snippets
- When generating any Microsoft/Azure related code

## Usage:
Input a descriptive query or SDK/class/method name. Optional 'language' parameter filters results.

Eligible languages: csharp, javascript, typescript, python, powershell, azurecli, al, sql, java, kusto, cpp, go, rust, ruby, php.

query.description: a descriptive query, SDK name, method name or code snippet related to Microsoft/Azure products, services, platforms, developer tools, frameworks, APIs or SDKs

language.description: Optional parameter specifying the programming language of code snippets to retrieve. Can significantly improve search quality if provided. Eligible values: csharp javascript typescript python powershell azurecli al sql java kusto cpp go rust ruby php

name: microsoft_docs_fetch
title: Microsoft Docs Fetch
description:
Fetch complete content from a Microsoft documentation page and convert to markdown.

## When to Use:
- Search results are incomplete or truncated
- Need complete procedures, troubleshooting steps, or detailed explanations
- Found a highly relevant page in search results

## Workflow:
Use after microsoft_docs_search to get full content from high-value pages.

## URL Requirements:
Must be a valid microsoft.com domain URL.

## Returns:
Markdown with headings, code blocks, tables, and links preserved.

url.description: URL of the Microsoft documentation page to read
